tools.name: aieph_search
tools.description: Look up the shared programming knowledge cache for error meanings, library usage, and how-tos. Do not send user code, files, or chat history—general questions only. Privacy: queries are PII-masked and logged anonymously. Details: aieph.dev/privacy

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aieph_search · Private data: aieph_search · Public sink: aieph_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aieph_search · Private data: aieph_search · Public sink: aieph_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
